items.t: Why Is Wells Fargo (WFC) Losing A $1.3 Billion Team While Bitcoin ETF Holdings Grow?
items.sum: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has lost a multigenerational financial advisor group overseeing about US$1.3b in client assets to &Partners. The departing wealth management team had been based at Wells Fargo and served clients across multiple generations within families. items.t: Wells Fargo grapples with change in venerable business line
items.sum: The San Francisco-based banking giant is grappling with the impact of major changes in the food, beverage and agribusiness sector, including big shifts in how Americans eat and drink.
